headline: Denso Corporation Manages Ransomware Incident with Minimal Disruption to Operations
body: Denso Corporation, a leading automotive parts supplier, encountered a ransomware attack that hit its administrative and scheduling IT systems. Nonetheless, critical machinery functions were largely unaffected as the company swiftly applied manual workarounds. While there could be slight hiccups in some delivery schedules, Denso assures customers these will be minimal. To ensure openness, customer plants have been informed about the situation.
